biomarkers.name: Same as DLBCL_GCB (treated as DLBCL)
biomarkers.clinical_use: See DLBCL_GCB. Often lacks t(14;18) despite FL morphology; more DLBCL-like biology

biomarkers.name: BCL2 rearrangement / t(14;18)(q32;q21)
biomarkers.prevalence: Less frequent than in grades 1-2/3A; often absent in grade 3B
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports conventional follicular lymphoma biology when present, but absence is common in grade 3B and does not exclude the diagnosis

biomarkers.name: IRF4 rearrangement
biomarkers.clinical_use: Important differential consideration in follicular-pattern large B-cell proliferations, especially Waldeyer ring/pediatric and young adult presentations; not a hallmark driver of typical grade 3B FL

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Sheets of centroblasts in follicular architecture — approaching diffuse large B-cell lymphoma morphology
variants: FL grade 3B (often lacks t(14;18); molecularly closer to DLBCL)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: As per DLBCL — treated as aggressive lymphoma
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Follicular architecture with sheets of centroblasts

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Germinal centre B cells with predominantly centroblastic differentiation, often lacking t(14;18)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Sheets of centroblasts in follicular architecture approaching DLBCL morphology; often lacks t(14;18) despite follicular architecture
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Biologically more DLBCL-like than FL — represents distinct entity despite follicular morphology; molecular studies show closer relationship to DLBCL
